summary: Full backend + frontend testing for AWS CloudForge Cards. 13/13 pytest tests passed against public URL covering all endpoints (root, cards, deal, score, leaderboard, validation errors, overengineering penalty, LLM commentary). Frontend Playwright e2e verified Landing -> Play (3 rounds) -> Leaderboard -> How to Play. Six sub-scores render with reasons, AI commentary (~941 chars) generated successfully via emergentintegrations + claude-sonnet-4-6.

ui_bugs.issue: After completing round 3, session/summary text appears but data-testid='leaderboard-name-input' and data-testid='save-score-button' could not be found via DOM query. Save-to-leaderboard flow from session summary needs verification.

action_items: Verify that the save-score form (leaderboard-name-input + save-score-button) is rendered with correct data-testid attributes after the 3rd round completes; if it sits behind a separate 'View summary' button or modal, ensure the testids exist on the visible inputs.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/game/deal with unknown scenario_id returns 404 (HTTPException) while POST /api/game/score with unknown scenario returns 400 via ValueError->400. Consistent but worth noting.
seed_data.py has 31 service cards rather than 30 (one extra) - acceptable per problem statement.
commentary.py gracefully falls back to rule-based summary on LLM failure - good defensive design.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); consider FastAPI lifespan handlers for future.
Leaderboard limit query param not validated (could be abused with huge values).
seed_data_creation: Inserted one TEST_player leaderboard entry (score 77.5) via tests; safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~20s and covers all endpoints incl. LLM commentary. For frontend save-flow verification, check the post-round-3 view in /app/frontend/src/pages/Play.jsx for the leaderboard-name-input/save-score-button rendering condition.
